Maya P: Heads-up: docs preview failed on the SDK migration guide - linkcheck and md-lint. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/12901 :grimacing:
Ravi G: Which file? I was just editing the Python examples.
Maya P: docs/guides/sdk-migration.md. Linkcheck says missing anchor for the python snippet, and md-lint complains about line-length in the code block.
Nina L: I can patch the code block wrapping, but anchor mismatch is oddwe intentionally renamed the header to be friendlier. Could add an explicit anchor to keep backward compat.
docs-bot: docs-ci-preview #12901 status: failed  linkcheck(1), md-lint(1)  rerun with `./ci docs-preview --pr 12901`
Ravi G: Quick fix: add `<!-- anchor: python-embed -->` above the header and reflow the long comment lines. I'll open a tiny PR.
Maya P: Please tag me as reviewer; we want this merged before the docs freeze at 17:00.
Ravi G: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/431 - small wrapper and anchor comment. CI kicked.
docs-bot: docs-ci-preview #12902 status: success  all checks passed. Preview: https://preview.docs.internal/redwood/guides/sdk-migration.html
Maya P: Nice. Merging now.
Nina L: For the CONTRIBUTING note - let's add a line about preserving anchors when renaming headers. Small quality-of-life win.
Maya P: Good call. I'll add that as a follow-up doc PR so it's not gating the release.
